text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Hishi Amazon—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hmm...? Oho, look at this neat stuff!

Following her gaze, I saw a crane game 
filled with Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You know, we have some new underclassmen 
moving into the dorms soon.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I was thinking of giving you some kind of 
souvenir. Wouldn't that plushie be just 
perfect?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Right?! All right! Let's go ahead and win, 
win, win a whole bunch—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...or so I thought, but I don't have 
enough cash on me right now! Dammit!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What?! Trainee, you're telling me you'll 
win it in my place?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Alright! I'll be right here watching 
your spirit, Trainee! Go ahead and win as 
much as you can!
—I can't afford to lose this game!!
